title: Pan-Seared Padron Peppers with Crunchy German Crust
description: A French-inspired dish featuring pan-seared Padron peppers topped with a crunchy German-style crust.
instructions: Rinse the Padron peppers and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a shallow dish, mix together the gluten-free breadcrumbs, panko breadcrumbs, and chopped parsley.
Dip each pepper into the breadcrumb mixture, coating evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the coated peppers for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the peppers are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
